About Me

I make data tell the right story.

I'm a Data Analyst based in Rajahmundry, India — recently certified by Microsoft as a Fabric Data Engineer and trained through IIM Skills' Analytics Master Course. I work at the intersection of SQL, Power BI, Excel, and Python, and I find genuine satisfaction in turning a chaotic spreadsheet into a dashboard someone actually uses.

My background is in Computer Science (MCA, BVC College of Engineering). I didn't start out knowing what a CTE was — I got here by building things, breaking them, and figuring out why. That hands-on approach still shapes how I work today.

When I'm not writing queries, I'm usually reading about business intelligence trends, experimenting with new DAX patterns, or trying to squeeze one more insight out of a dataset I probably should have closed an hour ago.

SQL Power User DAX & Data Modeling ETL Pipelines Business Intelligence Storytelling with Data
